title.narrative: Apoyo al programa "Progresando con Solidaridad"
Support for the program "progressing with Solidarity"

description.narrative: The Project will support the Social Protection System to improve efficiency and effectiveness of social assistance spending. Specific objectives are: i) to support conditional cash transfer, Progresando con Solidaridad, improving consumption levels of poor household and promoting access to health care and education services; ii) to improve job insertion opportunities for youth; and iii) to support strengthening of the Monitoring and Evaluation System.
